analysis.session_summary: The overnight tape belonged to the yen: JPY gained +1.054% against majors, USD/JPY fell -173.7 pips to 154.294, and CHF/JPY dropped -208.8 pips. The 10:00 headline 'Yen Climbs To Highest Level Since May, Exceeding Intervention Boost' drove -82.5 pips of the USD/JPY leg, while most other legs had no clear catalyst. DXY slipped -0.202% and VIX rose +1.888%, but the broad USD move was modest. GBP Monetary Policy Report Hearings at 15:15 are the only scheduled event ahead.

themes.evidence: JPY +1.054% vs majors; USD/JPY -173.7 pips; CHF/JPY -208.8 pips; Yen Climbs To Highest Level Since May headline at 10:00.

themes.theme: Broad USD soft, high-beta FX mixed
themes.evidence: DXY -0.202%; USD -0.226% vs majors; NZD -0.416% weakest; AUD -0.066%; GBP +0.003%.

themes.theme: Geopolitical headlines produced isolated, mostly weak FX reactions
themes.evidence: Trump Canada dollar imbalance headline accounted for 81% of the USD/CAD first leg and 92% of USD/ZAR first leg; Iran/Hormuz headlines had no measured reaction.

scenarios.name: JPY strength extends
scenarios.thesis: JPY gained +1.054% vs majors, USD/JPY closed near its range low at 154.294, and the 10:00 yen headline still has no competing catalyst; momentum can carry into the quiet calendar.
scenarios.invalidation: USD/JPY recovers back above 154.294 and VIX fades back below 16.23553.

pair_paths.rationale: USD/JPY range_pips was 222.2 and close near low; extending can retest the lower end of that range.
CHF/JPY range_pips was 245.1 and closed near low; JPY strength vs CHF continues.
EUR/USD range_pips was 30.0 and mixed legs suggest no clear direction while USD is soft.

scenarios.name: Consolidation ahead of GBP hearings
scenarios.thesis: The calendar is thin except for GBP Monetary Policy Report Hearings at 15:15, and most overnight legs had no clear catalyst, so the tape is likely range-bound.
triggers: GBP/USD stays within its 42.1 pip range
EUR/USD holds within its 30.0 pip range
scenarios.invalidation: A breakout beyond the measured range_pips in EUR/USD or GBP/USD.

pair_paths.rationale: GBP/USD range_pips was 42.1 and the pair closed near its high, but event risk can keep it inside.
EUR/USD range_pips was 30.0 and there is no directional catalyst.
USD/JPY may consolidate after a large -173.7 pip move within its 222.2 range.

scenarios.name: USD stabilization / risk bounce
scenarios.thesis: DXY -0.202% and SPX -0.247% with VIX +1.888% have moved to short-term extremes; a rebound in risk appetite can lift USD against high-beta FX even if JPY remains firm.
triggers: GBP Monetary Policy Report Hearings strike a hawkish tone lifting GBP/USD
scenarios.invalidation: USD/JPY makes fresh lows below 154.294 and VIX rises further.

pair_paths.rationale: GBP/USD rallied +26.8 pips to close at 1.35464; a hawkish BoE hearing could extend to the top of its 42.1 range.
USD/CAD closed near its range low at 0.14; a USD bounce could push back up within its 36.6 range.
Short-term rebound from a deeply oversold close near 0.11 of range could target the upper part of the 222.2 range.

risks.risk: Geopolitical escalation in the Strait of Hormuz
risks.why_it_matters: Headlines about Iran shipping strikes and U.S. attacks on tankers can trigger oil and safe-haven flows, though no measured reaction appeared overnight.
risks.watch: Brent/USD near 98.866 and further Iran/Hormuz headlines

risks.risk: Japan intervention or BoJ policy response
risks.why_it_matters: JPY +1.054% and USD/JPY -173.7 pips closed near the low; further yen strength may invite verbal or actual intervention.
The only scheduled event is GBP Monetary Policy Report Hearings at 15:15; a hawkish or dovish tone can move GBP crosses.
Trump's Canada dollar imbalance headline drove 81% of USD/CAD's first leg and 92% of USD/ZAR's first leg; further protectionist comments can whipsaw CAD, ZAR, and MXN.

analysis.calendar_ahead_note: The only scheduled item is GBP Monetary Policy Report Hearings at 15:15; with no measured event reactions in the overnight tape, this hearing can set the near-term GBP tone and spill into EUR/GBP and GBP/USD.
